yearsNote: From each project's git history (first to last commit). ICE 2025 covers the 2025 programme and its 2026 archive.
thumbsNote: Cards with an `og` page show a local copy of that page's share image, then swap in the current og:image live through the Worker (/api/og). ICE 2025 has no share image, so it keeps a screenshot; ICEHub has no public site.
cardsNote: Cards show only things people use. Backends and product sites are listed as parts of their product (hover the parts chip).
